commands:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
WT="/private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-next-preview-v37"
BR="v4.13.2-staging"
EXPECTED="334a6c373b179061dd8cb544743b26fae34c4e50"
test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
VERSION=$(python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; print(json.loads((pathlib.Path.home()/"local-agent/chat_bridge/manifest.json").read_text())["version"])')
test "$VERSION" = "0.3.1"
if [ -d "$WT" ]; then git -C "$LA" worktree remove "$WT"; fi
if git -C "$LA" show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BR"; then git -C "$LA" branch -d "$BR"; fi
if git -C "$LA" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$BR" >/dev/null 2>&1; then git -C "$LA" push origin --delete "$BR"; fi
echo "PRODUCTION_HEAD=$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PRODUCTION_DIRTY=$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "CHAT_BRIDGE_VERSION=$VERSION"
if git -C "$LA" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$BR" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo STAGING_REMOTE_PRESENT=1; exit 1; else echo STAGING_REMOTE_PRESENT=0; fi
